analogs.class: GABA benzodiazepine site receptor inverse agonist

analogy.rationale: GABA uptake inhibitors block SLC6A1/GAT1 to raise extracellular GABA, but these cell lines are non-neuronal and express little GABAergic machinery, so transcriptional responses should be weak; the closest reference classes are other GABA-receptor-directed and sigma-receptor ligands, which share limited downstream signaling overlap.
